name: acquisition_price_2012
explanation: Facebook paid this amount to acquire Instagram in 2012.

name: valuation_feb_2011
explanation: Instagram valuation after reaching 1 million monthly active users (MAU = monthly active users).

name: us_ad_revenue_2026
explanation: Projected annual Instagram advertising revenue in the United States.

name: avg_cpc_feed_ad
explanation: Average cost per click (CPC) for an Instagram feed advertisement.

name: avg_cpc_story_ad
explanation: Average cost per click (CPC) for an Instagram Story advertisement.

name: instagram_shopping_gmv
explanation: Estimated gross merchandise value (GMV = total value of goods sold) attributed to Instagram Shopping.

name: acquisition_cost_per_mau_2012
explanation: Facebook acquisition price divided by roughly 30 million monthly active users (MAU = monthly active users) at the time of acquisition.

name: revenue_per_us_ad_user_year
explanation: Projected United States Instagram advertising revenue divided by United States Instagram ad audience, producing revenue per monetizable user per year.

name: revenue_per_us_ad_user_month
explanation: Projected United States Instagram advertising revenue per monetizable user per month, derived from annual revenue per ad-reachable user.

name: revenue_per_us_ad_user_day
explanation: Projected United States Instagram advertising revenue per monetizable user per day, derived from annual revenue per ad-reachable user.

name: revenue_per_us_active_user_year
explanation: Projected United States Instagram advertising revenue divided by estimated active Instagram users in the United States, producing revenue per active user per year.

name: revenue_per_user_minute_73m
explanation: Projected United States Instagram advertising revenue per monetizable user-minute, assuming 73 minutes of daily Instagram use.

name: revenue_per_user_minute_33_9m
explanation: Projected United States Instagram advertising revenue per monetizable user-minute, assuming 33.9 minutes of daily Instagram use.

name: revenue_per_user_hour_73m
explanation: Projected United States Instagram advertising revenue per monetizable user-hour, assuming 73 minutes of daily Instagram use.

name: revenue_per_user_session
explanation: Projected United States Instagram advertising revenue per user session, assuming 12 or more app opens per day.
